overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long SNDK Daily ETF (SNXX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK), net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. SNXX was launched on Jan 26, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
